description: This source file defines data structures and enums related to cron job scheduling, custom session targeting, delivery modes, payloads, and logging for a cron management system within a project.

classes.name: CronJob
classes.description: Represents a scheduled cron job with associated metadata, schedule, payload, delivery options, and status.

classes.name: CronSchedule
classes.description: Defines different scheduling options for cron jobs, including specific times, intervals, or cron expressions.

classes.name: CronPayload
classes.description: Encapsulates different types of payloads that can be sent with cron jobs, such as system events or agent turns.

classes.name: CronDelivery
classes.description: Specifies delivery configuration for cron jobs, such as mode, channels, and recipients.

classes.name: CronJobState
classes.description: Tracks the execution state of a cron job, including timestamps for next run, last run, and errors.

classes.name: CronEvent
classes.description: Represents an event resulting from cron job execution, including status, duration, and errors.

classes.name: CronRunLogEntry
classes.description: Logs individual executions of cron jobs, capturing timing, outcomes, and errors.

classes.name: CronListResponse
classes.description: Response object encapsulating a list of cron jobs.

classes.name: CronRunsResponse
classes.description: Response object containing a list of cron run log entries.

classes.name: CronCustomSessionTarget
classes.description: Enum representing either predefined or custom session targets for cron jobs.

classes.name: CronSessionTarget
classes.description: Predefined session targets such as main, isolated, or current.

classes.name: CronWakeMode
classes.description: Wake modes indicating when a cron job should wake or activate.

classes.name: CronDeliveryMode
classes.description: Delivery modes for cron job notifications or messages.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method to create a CronCustomSessionTarget from a raw string value.

methods.name: parseAtDate
methods.description: Parses a string into a Date object based on ISO8601 format.

methods.name: formatIsoDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into an ISO8601 string.

methods.name: makeIsoFormatter
methods.description: Creates and configures an ISO8601DateFormatter instance.
